links.outcome: Agreement and F1 of retrieval-enhanced vs baseline LLM error labels against human validation on 100 messages
links.effect: Context-enhanced labels showed higher concordance (50% vs. 33%) and F1 (0.500 vs. 0.256) than baseline labels.
links.quote: Human validation on 100 messages demonstrated superior agreement (concordance = 50% vs. 33%) and performance (F1 = 0.500 vs. 0.256) of context-enhanced labels vs. baseline, supporting the use of our RAEC pipeline as AI guardrails for patient messaging.
